case_analysis.thread_summary: The thread discusses review and correction of Bluetooth PTS profile test reports before internal approval. A reviewer identified that the BAS and DIS profile versions in the reports were inconsistent with the ICS configuration used during testing. The tester corrected the reports and re-uploaded the revised BAS and DIS PTS reports for approval. The exchange also included confirmation that all required reports were properly uploaded to the shared repository.
case_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The main technical issue was that the BAS and DIS profile versions in the PTS reports did not match the versions defined by the ICS at test start. The reviewer emphasized that each profile must reference the correct single version derived from the ICS configuration. The thread also required correction of the ICS information embedded in the PTS report documentation itself. After correction, revised BAS and DIS reports were uploaded and routed for final approval review.
case_analysis.key_decision_logic: The correct Bluetooth qualification evidence must remain internally consistent between the ICS selections and the generated PTS reports. Since the ICS configuration defines the supported profile versions at the start of testing, the PTS report must reflect those exact versions without mismatch. Any inconsistency between reported profile versions and ICS-derived configuration requires report correction before approval.
case_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: If the PTS reports and ICS information remain inconsistent, the qualification evidence may fail internal review or later compliance validation. Incorrect profile version documentation can create traceability problems between the tested implementation and declared Bluetooth functionality. Missing revised reports in the shared repository can also delay approval and qualification workflow completion.
case_analysis.consulting_mistake: The initial PTS reports contained incorrect or inconsistent BAS and DIS profile version information relative to the ICS configuration used during testing. The mistake was corrected by updating both the profile version references and the ICS information in the reports, followed by re-uploading the corrected BAS and DIS reports for approval.
case_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Always verify that all Bluetooth PTS reports exactly match the ICS configuration and profile versions used during testing before submitting reports for approval or qualification evidence review.
